leadText: Pika Pika is the first ending theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Series: XY. It debuted in XY001, replacing Holding Hands of Pokémon the Series: Black & White. It uses the same animation from the corresponding Japanese ending theme, X Strait Y Scenery.
plainText:
Pika Pika is the first ending theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Series: XY. It debuted in XY001, replacing Holding Hands of Pokémon the Series: Black & White. It uses the same animation from the corresponding Japanese ending theme, X Strait Y Scenery.
